summary: xAI announced that its Grok Bot agent product, previously in limited beta, is now included with SuperGrok, Cursor Pro and Cursor Teams subscription plans.

mechanisms.reason: The product is described as autonomous digital teammates that run in parallel, work across apps, and complete delegated jobs with minimal human involvement.
mechanisms.quote: They're digital teammates you can message, run in parallel, and trust to finish work in the tools you already use.

mechanisms.reason: Expanding the agent to more subscription tiers and giving it separate usage allowances implies more calls and tokens served in aggregate.
mechanisms.quote: Grok Bot comes with its own usage, separate from your Grok and Cursor plans, so anything you hand off to a Bot won't count against your existing usage.

practices.reason: The multi-agent group-chat pattern and persistent cloud-based agent with browser/terminal access is a concrete design worth evaluating for our own agent pipelines.
practices.quote: Stand up a researcher, writer, and chief of staff. Put them in a group chat so they pass work between themselves, and you're not in the middle.
